name: The Innovation Horizon Brief
axiom: Fund three horizons at once or the third one quietly disappears.
trigger: Annual R&D allocation and innovation reviews, where the current business always wins the budget argument.

steps.text: Horizon one: keep the core running and efficient.
Horizon two: expand what already earns.
Horizon three: options that could replace both.
Balance: a protected share for each, reviewed on its own terms.

antiPattern.violation: Judging horizon three by horizon one's payback period, which guarantees it is cut before it can produce anything.
antiPattern.remediation: Give each horizon its own metric and a protected share of the budget. A single yardstick eliminates the future.
